This knob displays an array of control points.
A particular control point in the array is selected for display by using the arrow knobs.The left/right arrows will changed the column index of the control point.The up/down arrows will changed the row index of the control point.The indexing starts at 0.
Each control point is displayed with five XYZ values corresponding to the position, right tangent, left tangent, up tangent, and down tangent.The tangent values are relative to the position value.For control points along the edge of the card, tangent values are displayed only if they are valid.For example, the lower left corner control point will only have the up and right tangents displayed.

description.plain_text: This creates a card. A card is the simplest type of object you can add to a scene.It's merely a plane onto which you can map a texture.A card object may be deformed as a bilinear or bicubic object with controls contained in the card's deform parameters.
